class_id: a hand-kept list of which checks read a field misses checks, so a value the list does not reach is cleared on a refusal that compared against an unknown number
feature: the #1420 re-read clear (scraper/src/services/reread-answer-clear.ts clearRereadAnswers, OD-153/OD-158/OD-160) for every document type and every clearable column, whenever the same document's envelope also holds an OCR value the item 44 guard (scraper/scripts/ocr_pages.py guard_ambiguous_thousands) marked ambiguous
symptom: an OCR'd number printed 'd.ddd' ("1.785") may be Rs 1.785 or Rs 1,785; the guard MISSES it, and demotes to MISSED only the refusals whose check name appears in CROSS_FIELD_CHECK_INPUTS, a list typed by hand from extract_filing.py's call sites. Any cross-field check not on the list (pe_equals_price_over_diluted_eps, price_over_secondary_waca_equals_printed_multiple, any check added later) stays REFUSED against that unknown number, and a REFUSED clears the stored value (OD-153). Wider shape: a protection that needs a hand-maintained enumeration of its dependents is a detector, and a detector of an open set misses the next member; the guarantee belongs at the choke point every case passes through.
first_seen: 2026-10-02 -- IPODhan PR #1472 (item 45). Independent Tier A review round 1 (MAJOR-1): floor 1,700 refused against OCR cap '1.785' would clear ipos.priceRangeMin; round 1 fix added CROSS_FIELD_CHECK_INPUTS. Round 2: the list misses pe_equals_price_over_diluted_eps (extract_filing.py ~1751-1756) and price_over_secondary_waca_equals_printed_multiple (~1887-1895), so an ambiguous cap still lets pe_at_cap clear financial_data.peRatio (filing-clearable-columns.ts). Reproduced in round 3 on the real guard: an envelope with OCR cap 1.785 and a REFUSED pe_at_cap left pe_at_cap REFUSED after guard_ambiguous_thousands (reread-answer-clear.test.ts, 'the REAL extractor guard').
fix_prs: PR #1472 round 3: clearRereadAnswers keeps EVERY due clear (reason document_has_ambiguous_ocr, the marked fields named) when any envelope field, at any depth, carries ocr_ambiguous_thousands_separator / depends_on_ambiguous_ocr or the guard's ambiguous_token / depends_on_ambiguous_ocr key. The ocr_pages.py sibling demotion stays as the second layer.
detection_check: scraper/tests/unit/services/reread-answer-clear.test.ts 'a document with an ambiguous OCR value clears nothing': six checks (four on the list, two off it, one synthetic) each give zero clears and zero DB calls with an ambiguous cap and still clear without one; the real python guard's output is fed through the real clear path. Mutations: dropping the choke-point rule turns 8 cases red; blanking the marker scan turns 9 red. scraper/scripts/test_ocr_ambiguous_amounts.py pins the same-check-name demotion branch (red when that branch is removed).
